index_name: Uninstall Test Index (plugin dependency resolution fixture)

plugins.name: SharedDeps
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: A dependency of both toolboxpro and othersuite below - must survive uninstalling just one of them, since the other still needs it.

plugins.name: OrphanLib
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: A dependency of only toolboxpro below - uninstalling toolboxpro must cascade and remove this one too, since nothing else needs it.

plugins.name: ToolboxPro
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Depends on shareddeps and orphanlib. Uninstalling this must remove orphanlib (nothing else needs it) but leave shareddeps installed (othersuite still does).

plugins.name: OtherSuite
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Depends on shareddeps too, and stays installed throughout - proving the orphan check actually checks for other consumers rather than always cascading everything.
